analysis.failures: retain all completed runner records including failures; abandon remaining phases and score them
analysis.missing: no complete-panel estimate unless every preregistered cell exists exactly once
analysis.pair: public simulator seed x repeat index; fresh episode and provider request state per condition
analysis.repeats: average paired differences within seed first; seeds are the analysis units
analysis.retry: none; interrupted panels are incomplete; rerun the whole panel in a new directory, retain both
analysis.uncertainty: descriptive seed-level standard error; null for fewer than two seeds; no significance test

protocol.clock: engine phase guard disabled in BOTH arms; bounded calls and socket inactivity timeout, not wall deadline
protocol.context: reset history at every phase; journal generated in both arms, retained across phases only in treatment
protocol.observations: only current phase coordinates, current-phase call/reply history, journal, tool schemas and brief
protocol.order: alternate condition order by seed index plus repeat index; serial execution
protocol.overflow: stop entire episode on budget, malformed response, provider or identity error; no truncation or retries
protocol.request_budget: max_request_chars bounds canonical JSON request characters, not wire bytes or tokens
protocol.sampling: openai-chat sends temperature 0; anthropic-messages sends no sampling parameters but a registered effort with adaptive thinking; sampling seed unsupported, not sent; provider nondeterminism remains
protocol.seed_visibility: public demonstration seeds only; numeric simulator seed never included in model request
protocol.tools: frozen 2.0 tool semantics except write_memo unavailable in BOTH conditions
